claim_boundary: Pilot and package checks cannot establish quality, gap closure, noninferiority, savings, or live host delivery.

shared.client: Codex desktop intended; exact task tuple and native host-memory isolation require a feasibility receipt
shared.reasoning_effort: medium where available; unavailable combinations remain missing cells
shared.tools: same authorized file/shell tools within each matched task; no paid API key
shared.attempt_policy: Record every first attempt, repair, timeout, retry, and escalation. No replacement of a missing model.
shared.privacy: Synthetic/disposable fixture roots only; no user project enrollment, prompt/transcript storage, or hidden reasoning capture.
shared.usage: Record exposed input, cached input, output, reasoning aggregate, wall time, tool calls, scans, retrieval, policy calls, and failures separately. Unavailable fields are null, not zero.
shared.quality_judging: Check artifact and relevant behavior tests first. Human bilingual blinded review is preferred; model judgments are supplemental and identified.
shared.host_memory: Primary comparison requires demonstrated isolation in a disposable client profile; otherwise label memory effects confounded.

EVAL-01.additional_control: Paired C/D replay from one frozen first-session artifact and memory state before hidden follow-up.

EVAL-02.purpose: Inexpensive-model quality gain and remaining Sol gap

EVAL-03.adaptive_ablation: For each model hold source, memory, canonical method access, effort, and tools fixed; vary optional wrapper only.
EVAL-03.primary_resource: wall time; total usage reported as secondary until billing visibility is established
EVAL-03.quality_gate: No critical failure or weakened required check; held-out noninferiority margin to be frozen after pilot variance.

EVAL-05.purpose: Natural collaboration in English and Korean
arms: same model and effort with and without v1.5

held_out_study.reason: Numerical margins and sample size depend on capability smoke and pilot variance; no held-out outcome may run before a separate immutable preregistration.
